## Tools & Resources I've Built

### Open Science Knowledge Check

A self-assessment quiz on open science and scholarly publishing, built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and Observable JS. Lets researchers gauge and build their understanding of open-science concepts at their own pace.

[Try the quiz](https://bellaratmelia.github.io/os-knowledge-check/){.btn .btn-outline-primary role="button"} [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/bellaratmelia/os-knowledge-check){.btn .btn-outline-secondary role="button"}

### Introductory R for Social Sciences

An open, self-paced course website for teaching R to social-science and humanities researchers, built in Quarto and taught to SMU researchers since 2023.

[View the course](https://smu-libraries.github.io/r-socsci/){.btn .btn-outline-primary role="button"} [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/smu-libraries/r-socsci){.btn .btn-outline-secondary role="button"} [Earlier materials](https://bellaratmelia.github.io/introductory-r-socsci/){.btn .btn-outline-secondary role="button"}

*More workshop and teaching materials are on my [GitHub](https://github.com/bellaratmelia).*

## Initiatives & Events I've Led

### FORCE11 & FORCE2026 *(ongoing)*

-  Vice President of [FORCE11](https://force11.org/), an international community advancing open scholarship, research communication, and e-research.
-  Co-chair of the organizing committee for FORCE2026, the community's flagship conference.

### AI for Research Week 2024

![](https://library.smu.edu.sg/sites/library.smu.edu.sg/files/banner-image/Banner_AI_Week24v02_04v.png){fig-alt="Banner for SMU Libraries AI for Research Week 2024" width="25%"}

-  Led a team of 7 in organizing AI for Research Week 2024, defining event scope, managing logistics, and overseeing speaker recruitment.
-  Co-facilitated two hands-on workshops:
    -  [Try it Together: Transcribe Your Audio with Whisper API](https://ink.library.smu.edu.sg/ai_research_week/Programme/Programme/3/) – guiding participants through real-time transcription using the Whisper API.
    -  [Try it together - AI-powered search tools: Elicit, SciSpace, Connected Papers, Researchrabbit, and Undermind.ai](https://ink.library.smu.edu.sg/ai_research_week/Programme/Programme/2/) – demonstrated advanced AI tools, including Elicit and Scispace, for improving research workflows and literature discovery.

[Visit project website](https://library.smu.edu.sg/AI4ResearchWeek#programme){.btn .btn-outline-primary role="button"}

### Generate Your L(AI)brary Hackathon 2023

![](https://library.smu.edu.sg/sites/library.smu.edu.sg/files/library/newsEvents/Hackathon2023/Banner_HackV04b_RG.png){fig-alt="Banner for SMU Libraries Generate Your L(AI)brary Hackathon 2023" width="25%"}

-  Led a team of 8 in organizing the Generate Your L(AI)brary Hackathon 2023, overseeing the event’s scope, theme development, judge and mentor recruitment, and comprehensive planning.
-  Conducted an introductory Python workshop to equip participants with foundational skills in preparation for the hackathon.
-  The winning prototype went on to become a research project to implement the concept within SMU Libraries.

[Visit project website](https://researchguides.smu.edu.sg/hackathon-2023){.btn .btn-outline-primary role="button"}
